reciprocal.link: SP007 — Keep thought and world in parallel
reciprocal.why: SP007 states the parallelism as Spinoza's Ethics II Prop. VII proposition: the order and connection of ideas is the same as the order and connection of things

reciprocal.link: SP021 — Take envy seriously as hatred
reciprocal.why: Spinoza's definition connects envy with pain at another's good fortune and pleasure at their misfortune.

reciprocal.link: SP022 — Practice gratitude as repayment of love
reciprocal.why: A Spinozist account of gratitude as wanting to benefit someone who has benefited us out of love.

reciprocal.link: SP028 — See decisions as victories of the strongest appetite
reciprocal.why: For comparison: Spinoza's account of mental decision and bodily appetite in Ethics III.2.
